summary: Iter 39 (filed under iteration_40.json since iter39.json already existed). Verified the RSVP/payment/check-in route extraction into /app/backend/routes/rsvps.py and the GearAdmin legacy editor iter38 patches. Backend pytest: 7/7 PASS (free RSVP toggle increments counters + appears in /me/events + second call removes it; paid event returns 402 with '/payment/confirm' hint in detail; cancelled event returns 400; PUT /events/{id}/rsvp/guests edits guest list in-place without toggling; POST /events/{id}/payment/confirm creates pending event_ticket transaction without an RSVP; PUT /transactions/{tx_id}/approve-event-ticket as admin completes the tx + creates RSVP + is idempotent on re-call; GET /checkin/lookup/{token} returns 400 on a bad token and 200 with ticket info on a valid signed JWT; POST /checkin/scan/{token} returns 403 for non-admin, records check-in once for admin, and is idempotent on a second scan). Frontend live UI as admin: /admin -> Gear tab -> 'New item' dialog renders with all required testids gear-admin-name-html (1), gear-admin-external-block (1), gear-admin-is-external (1), gear-admin-cover-upload (1); gear-admin-external-url is gated (0 initially -> 1 visible after toggling External link mode). No event-cover-upload testid present inside the dialog (testid collision from iter38 stays fixed). Created a new gear item via the dialog -> 'Saved' toast appeared, item rendered in the list with correct price + In stock, GET /api/gear shows the row with name_html='' / is_external_link=false / external_url='' defaults. Cleanup via DELETE /api/gear/{id} returned 200.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rsvps.py is clean: shared _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket helper avoids duplication between free + paid + admin-approve paths; module exposes the helper on register.* for any back-compat shim. ticket QR token minted with the same JWT_SECRET/HS256 as decoder.

rsvp_event() correctly returns 402 for paid events with detail containing '/payment/confirm', 400 for cancelled events, 400 for umbrella (parent) events; toggle deletes the rsvp doc and decrements counters on second call.

event_payment_confirm() blocks duplicate submissions when a pending/completed tx already exists for the same user+event (returns 400). Auto-approve path only fires when user.trust_zeffy AND receipt format matches classify_zeffy_receipt — safe default.
admin_approve_event_ticket() is idempotent: returns {ok:true, already:true, rsvp_id} on repeat calls instead of double-creating an RSVP.

checkin_scan() correctly enforces admin role with HTTP 403 for member, returns 410 if the underlying RSVP was cancelled (ticket invalidation), supports member + guest kinds, idempotent via existing-checkin lookup before insert.

Frontend Admin.jsx GearItemEditor: gear-admin-external-url is conditionally rendered only when is_external=true — this is correct UX but the testid count is 0 in default state; tests should toggle the checkbox first. emptyGear() at L2093 confirmed to include external_url, is_external_link, name_html keys via observed POST result.
No console errors during the admin login + gear-create flow (only a 401 on /api/auth/me before login which is expected, plus 2 unrelated 404s for static assets).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — GearAdmin dialog renders all required testids + no collision, gear creation persists end-to-end.
